title: Welcome page structure
question: Locked brief: one cinematic Event-hub old/new reveal, primary CTA to Events, secondary to Dashboard, Gemini-star tab. Keep Honest Clubhouse (Satoshi, B/W/grey, yellow accent). The roll assigned Peel Reveal — keep it, take a fused challenger, re-roll, or play it straight.

options.label: Peel Reveal
options.thesis: A diamond-handled diagonal peel lifts v1 Event hub off v2 — welcome copy rides the sticker edge, not a boring header stack.
options.viewport: First viewport: oversized Event hub stage with diagonal peel at ~40%; “Welcome to Organisers Hub v2!” arcs the peeled corner; yellow Enter Events docks under the stage.
options.risk: Diagonal mask can feel gimmicky if the peel isn’t buttery and the screenshots aren’t crisp.

options.label: Stage Voices
options.lineage: Massin stage page · fused into Clubhouse
options.thesis: Old and New argue across a vertical reveal seam like two speakers — size is volume, the Event hub is the stage, Enter Events is the curtain call.
options.case: Beats Peel on theatrical energy; weaker if shouty type fights Satoshi restraint.
options.viewport: BEFORE / AFTER labels collide at different scales across a center seam; Event hub fills both halves; CTA under the proscenium.
options.risk: Typographic theater can overshadow the UI proof organisers came to judge.

options.label: Develop Reveal
options.thesis: Drag develops the new Event hub out of a silver ghost of v1 — yellow safelight wash, timer tick, print snaps into v2.
options.case: Strongest metaphor for reveal; may read too moody for a bright sports welcome.
options.viewport: Amber-yellow washed stage; horizontal develop wipe; Welcome title as grease-pencil notes; Enter Events as the fixer bath commit.
options.risk: Safelight mood can feel dark-mode adjacent against Clubhouse daylight.

options.label: Desk Instrument
options.thesis: The reveal is a knurled scrub on a keycap grid; one yellow commit key is Enter Events; amber readout says NOW.
options.case: Clearest tactile control for the slider; cooler/nerdier than sports-club energy.
options.viewport: Instrument bezel frames the Event hub pair; knob/scrub owns the reveal; yellow key under the bezel.
options.risk: Hardware metaphor may feel foreign to community-sport organisers.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A familiar What’s-new SaaS welcome: centered headline, feature cards, one CTA — executed at full craft, no peel theater.
canonCard.viewport: Centered Welcome to Organisers Hub v2, three feature cards with before/after thumbs, yellow Enter Events.
